name: browser-use
headline: MCP Windows Automation - Automate Windows tasks
short_description: AI-Powered Windows Automation Server using Model Context Protocol (MCP) | Control Windows apps, automate tasks, and manage systems through natural language commands with Claude, ChatGPT & other AI assistants | 80+ automation tools
author: mukul975

sections.overview:
MCP Windows Server transforms your Windows PC into an intelligent automation hub controlled by AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT. Built on Anthropic's Model Context Protocol, it provides 200+ automation tools across system control, file operations, web automation, image processing, Office integration, and security tasks. Simply issue natural language commands—take screenshots, manage processes, create backups, or automate Office workflows—and the server translates them into secure system actions. The framework includes built-in command filtering and validation to ensure safe execution, making it ideal for developers, power users, and automation teams seeking hands-free Windows control through AI.
Automate file management and backup operations through natural language
Control Windows applications and system processes via Claude Desktop
Extract data from web pages and perform automated web scraping
Generate screenshots, perform OCR, and manipulate images programmatically
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/mukul975/mcp-windows-automation`
sections.usage:
```
Act as an MCP Windows Automation Server. I want to automate a task on my Windows system. Here are the details: [TASK], [APPLICATION], [FREQUENCY], [TRIGGER]. Provide the necessary MCP commands to set this up.
```
